name: TournamentBracketManager
tagline: Run the whole tournament desk – draws, brackets, results and court schedule – in one Power Platform control.
description: A complete competition app for clubs, leagues and event organisers: seed and generate single-elimination, double-elimination or groups-plus-knock-out draws with automatic byes, enter results and watch winners (and losers in double elimination) advance automatically, follow live group standings, create the knock-out from the group tables, and schedule ready matches across courts with clash and rest-time checks. Works with demo data the moment it is dropped on a canvas screen, model-driven form or Power Pages page.
features: Seeding with standard seed placement and automatic byes
Single elimination with optional third-place play-off
Double elimination with losers bracket and grand-final reset
Round-robin groups with configurable W/D/L points and tie-breaks
Result entry with validation, walkovers and retirements
Auto-advancement with full ChangedRecordsJson for Power Fx
Reopen results safely (blocked once the next round is played)
Auto-schedule ready matches on courts with minimum rest
Court clash and rest-time conflict detection
Bulk mark ready / postpone / set court / clear schedule / delete
Undo, CSV export, read-only results-board mode
Phone layout with bottom navigation and round chips
